How I work with you

A straightforward process with clear deliverables and review points.

01 / BRIEF

Tell me what you're making

We define the publication, audience, content, page count, format and final use.

02 / DIRECTION

Agree on a visual style

We review a cover and representative spread before the full layout is developed.

03 / LAYOUT

Build the full document

I apply the agreed type, grid, imagery and information hierarchy across your pages.

04 / HANDOVER

Review and receive your files

We complete agreed revisions and prepare the relevant PDF, INDD and IDML deliverables.
